title: Ssamjang Dipping Paste
summary: Doenjang and gochujang stirred with garlic, spring onion, honey and sesame oil, finished with sesame seeds.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the doenjang, gochujang, garlic, spring onion, honey and sesame oil together until evenly blended.

steps.title: Taste
steps.text: Add a little more gochujang if you want more heat.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Scatter the sesame seeds over the top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Dab onto grilled beef and wrap in crisp lettuce leaves.

tips: Grate the garlic finely so there are no raw chunks.
Loosen with 1 tsp water if your doenjang is very stiff.
Also good with raw cucumber or carrot sticks.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 1 week. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
